### Creativity
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-feb-9-2009-11599190.html
Passage: Exodus 35:21
Points:
- God never changes in His being, yet His methods and workings remain fresh and creative.
- Believers are called to imitate God by remaining open, flexible, and willing to innovate.
- People tend to settle into maintaining routines rather than embracing God-directed changes.
- A stirred and willing spirit readily steps out into new ventures wherever God leads.

### Israel's Generosity
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israels-generosity
Passage: Exodus 35:4-29
Points:
- God accomplishes His kingdom building by stirring the hearts of His people to give.
- Leaders rightly present clear ministry needs so God's people can respond.
- Offerings should be made willingly and prudently out of what one actually possesses.
- Serving God requires offering practical skills and time alongside material wealth.
- Trusting God with our resources removes anxiety because He faithfully provides.
